text: Powering Visionary Growth. General Atlantic is a global investment leader — the dedicated partner for entrepreneurs and investors building long-term value. About Us Our Approach We were founded on the belief that entrepreneurs can be incredible agents of transformational change. Since 1980, we have identified talent and technologies with great potential — empowering innovators with patient capital, operational expertise, and a global platform to scale their ambitions. Our Story One global platform fueling innovation across strategies Growth Equity Accelerating the growth of category-leading companies by providing the strategic counsel, resources and value-add capabilities they need to realize the next chapter of their stories. Learn More Credit Delivering a comprehensive suite of strategic capital solutions to high-quality businesses that need a strategic partner during key phases of their lifecycles. Learn More Energy Transition Identifying and scaling growth companies with energy transition solutions to help accelerate the net zero transition. Learn More Infrastructure Investing in long-term, equitable growth in critical infrastructure across the energy transition, digitization, and the transformation of supply chains through Actis. Learn More Assets Under Management $130B Total Capital Invested Since Inception $121B Global Locations 21 Partnerships with Depth Our platform is made to build durable, world-changing companies. Our deep sector expertise, vast global infrastructure and network, and robust company building capabilities provide the tangible, targeted support to take businesses to the next level.
